parrafo_1.es: K&G Food Truck Burrito Y Mas opera sobre Palm Beach Blvd en Fort Myers. El menu pintado en el propio truck lo dice todo: tacos, sandwiches, burritos, wraps y quesadillas, ademas de un menu de desayuno aparte.
parrafo_1.en: K&G Food Truck Burrito Y Mas operates on Palm Beach Blvd in Fort Myers. The menu painted right on the truck says it all: tacos, sandwiches, burritos, wraps and quesadillas, plus a separate breakfast menu.

parrafo_2.es: Entre los platillos que mas mencionan sus clientes estan los burritos de pollo y las tortas de huevo con jamon y queso para desayunar.
parrafo_2.en: Among the dishes customers mention most are the chicken burritos and the ham, egg and cheese breakfast sandwiches.

texto.es: Estamos sobre Palm Beach Blvd en Fort Myers. Llama para confirmar si estamos en el lugar antes de ir.
texto.en: We're on Palm Beach Blvd in Fort Myers. Call ahead to confirm we're at the spot before heading over.

texto.es: Tacos, sandwiches, burritos, wraps o quesadillas, mas un menu de desayuno aparte.
texto.en: Tacos, sandwiches, burritos, wraps or quesadillas, plus a separate breakfast menu.

texto.es: Cada orden se hace fresca en la plancha del truck.
texto.en: Every order is made fresh on the truck's griddle.

texto.es: Roja o verde, a tu gusto, y un café caliente si pediste desayuno.
texto.en: Red or green, your choice, and a hot coffee if you ordered breakfast.

nota.es: Pregunta por el menú del día en la ventanilla: los precios pueden variar.
nota.en: Ask about the daily menu at the window: prices may vary.

texto.es: Los burritos de pollo son de los mas recomendados por nuestros clientes.
texto.en: Our chicken burritos are among the most recommended by customers.

texto.es: Huevo, jamon y queso, o con salchicha, hash browns y pan tostado.
texto.en: Ham, egg and cheese, or with sausage, hash browns and toast.

texto.es: Con pollo, cebolla y cilantro, o dobladas en la plancha con queso derretido.
texto.en: With chicken, onion and cilantro, or folded on the griddle with melted cheese.

texto.es: Disponible los domingos, anunciado en el propio menu del truck.
texto.en: Available on Sundays, listed right on the truck's own menu.

pie.es: También preparan sandwiches, wraps y panuchos estilo Veracruz, 3 por $10.
pie.en: They also make sandwiches, wraps and Veracruz-style panuchos, 3 for $10.

Can't wait to bring my family and friends!!! Thank you for being part of the community.
Incredible food at a really good price! $1 street tacos (chicken and ground beef) $2 street tacos (steak and chorizo). Will definitely come back!
My first time eating here….it smell as good as it taste…. Ill definitely be back not only tacos but for breakfast… the sauce is even good delicious 🤤 …
